text: Prometeon Tyre Group S.r.l. is controlled by China National Tyre & Rubber Co., Ltd (CNRC), a subsidiary of Sinochem Holdings. Sinochem says CNRC became the direct stakeholder of 38% of Prometeon's shares in 2022 and that the remaining shares are held by TP Industrial Holding S.p.A., a company controlled by CNRC (Aeolus Tyre holds 10%); CNRC later entrusted its stake to CNRC-controlled Aeolus Tyre.
short: Prometeon is controlled by CNRC, a Sinochem Holdings subsidiary.

source.name: Sinochem Holdings - CNRC acquires 38% share in Prometeon Tyre Group
source.quote: China National Tyre & Rubber Co., Ltd (CNRC), a subsidiary of Sinochem Holdings, completed the acquisition of the 38% share
source.note: The release also states: 'With this deal, CNRC has become the direct stakeholder of 38% of Prometeon's shares, while Aeolus holds a 10% stake. The remaining 52% is owned by TP Industrial Holding S.p.A. - a company controlled by CNRC.' and that CNRC will entrust its stake in PTG to Aeolus Tyre.

additionalSources.name: Portal Economia - Prometeon Tyre Group: Leadership in the Global Industrial Tire Market
additionalSources.quote: The group is currently 90% owned by China National Tire & Rubber Corporation (CNRC), part of the Sinochem conglomerate, while the remaining 10% is held by the Chinese tire manufacturer Aeolus.
